description: Parse a single portlet's XML wire document back into a portlet record and report the reconstructed domain state. The input payload is an XML string with a '<portlet>' root containing '<portlet-name>', '<portlet-class>', and one or more '<init-param>' elements. The parser must rebuild the record, exposing its identifier, its implementation class, and its initialization parameters as a name-to-value mapping. The reconstructed state is printed as a deterministic dump: the identifier, the class, the parameter count, then each parameter as a 'init.<name>=<value>' line with parameter names in ascending order.
